description: Propagate the EXACT SAME calm/uniform skeleton rule established in FEAT-001 to every remaining per-feature *Skeleton.tsx component and every route loading.tsx. The rule (texture reduced, visual weight evened, geometry preserved) is defined in FEAT-001's steps - read FEAT-001.json and apply it identically here. Each file below has its own load-bearing comments; preserve the reasoning and only change texture. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: RE-READ the rule in .agents/tasks/task-calm-skeletons/features/FEAT-001.json steps 1-2 (the RULE and the TEXTURE-vs-GEOMETRY test). Apply it identically. Canonical texture widths: {w-1/3, w-1/2, w-2/3, w-full}. Keep every fixed height, size-N box, aspect frame, grid/strip constant, breakpoint gate, safe-area inset, min-h row, ch-sized label, and TextLines type-scale class. Do not touch app/globals.css or components/ui/skeleton.tsx (done in FEAT-001).

app/(workspace)/listings/[id]/(detail)/loading.tsx (32 elements, second-busiest): KEEP the gallery frame (min-h-[22rem], the four 'size-14 rounded-md' rail thumbs - geometry), the carousel 'aspect-[4/5]' frame, the 'min-h-11' seller row, the 'size-7/size-10 rounded-full' avatars (they anchor their rows - keep as same-size neutral boxes), the 'size-12 rounded-full' action chips and 'size-8' icon reserves, the ml-region inset, and all h-7/h-8/h-10/h-5 control reserves. CHANGE: normalize the condition-pill texture to a neutral same-size box (it already reserves h-5 w-16 - keep size, it is already neutral rounded-full; leave it, it carries no shift), and normalize all TextLines text-run widths (w-28, w-3/5, w-24, w-32, w-2/3, w-1/3, w-4/5, w-1/2, w-36, w-20, w-16, w-full) to the canonical set while preserving the description's 4-line clamp reservation and the two-line meta reservations.

components/auth/AuthFormSkeleton.tsx (21): KEEP every field/button height (h-11, h-9, h-8), the min-h-11 rows, the 'size-5 rounded-sm' checkbox, the 'or' hairline rule, and the mode-conditional rows. CHANGE only the text-run widths (w-40, w-full, w-2/3, w-56, w-14, w-20, w-24, w-52, w-48, w-32) to the canonical set, keeping the sign-in-vs-sign-up conditional width logic (the collapse-on-sm second description line must stay).

components/listings/ItemFormSkeleton.tsx (21): apply the rule - keep all input/control heights, image upload frame reserves, and section structure; normalize text-run widths and any decorative shapes.

app/(workspace)/admin/(console)/loading.tsx (19): keep the SectionHeader, the five queue tiles, tab strip and table geometry; normalize texture widths and any decorative row shapes to canonical/neutral.
app/(workspace)/trades/new/loading.tsx (17): centred max-w-lg card - keep the requested-item strip thumb, field heights, and card structure; normalize text widths.

app/(workspace)/listings/mine/loading.tsx (15): management TABLE - keep ROW_GRID, the 'size-12 rounded-md' thumb, 'border border-transparent' focus reserve, the stat-card head reserves, and the h-[1.425rem] badge reserves (geometry). Normalize the title/meta text widths (titleWidth, w-2/5, w-14, w-6, labelWidth) to canonical where they are texture; KEEP labelWidth/titleWidth params if they encode real column proportions.
app/(workspace)/admin/arbitration/(queue)/loading.tsx (14): keep the SectionHeader (descriptionLines=2), tab strip, and row/record geometry; normalize texture widths.

components/deals/DealInviteSkeleton.tsx (12): keep BOTH shell branches (MarketplaceShellSkeleton vs PageShell), the useWorkspaceChrome staff gate, the 'size-16' card-fact thumbnail (geometry), the h-9/h-8 button reserves, the pb reserve, and the footer-note two-line reserve. Normalize the fact label/value text widths (w-32, w-56, w-28, w-12, w-36, w-24, w-3/4) to canonical.
app/(workspace)/sellers/[id]/loading.tsx (12): three stacked bands - keep band structure and any avatar/stat reserves (as same-size neutral boxes); normalize text widths.

app/(marketing)/safety/loading.tsx (11): keep the max-w-prose column, the cardtrade-warning callout box, the 'size-9 rounded-full' stage markers (they anchor the pl-12 timeline - keep as same-size neutral boxes), and the nested bordered boxes; normalize the many text-run widths (w-72, w-full, w-2/5, w-1/3, w-32, w-56, w-1/2, w-48, w-2/3, w-3/4) to canonical.

app/(workspace)/(home)/loading.tsx (10): keep the mobile hub bar cells (h-14, size-5 icon, h-3 label, the active-tab underline slot), the 'size-4 rounded-sm' / 'size-11 rounded-full' reserves, the GenreStripSkeleton h-11 pills (the width array ['w-16','w-28','w-32','w-36','w-24','w-44','w-28','w-24'] is a horizontal scroll strip - these reserve pill widths; you may normalize to a smaller repeating set but keep them h-11 and keep enough total width to fill the strip), the hidden md:block h-8 w-[190px] filter reserve, and the stat-row h-10 cells. This file mirrors catalog + chrome; be conservative - normalize only clear texture (the stat-row value widths row.value, the title/sub text widths) and leave the hub and genre strip pill widths if reducing them would shorten the scroll strip.
app/(workspace)/admin/arbitration/[kind]/[ref]/loading.tsx: keep status strip, back link, and section geometry; normalize text widths.

app/onboarding/loading.tsx: keep the StepFooter button reserve (h-9), the 'size-8 rounded-full' welcome-point markers (same-size neutral boxes), OnboardingSpineSkeleton, and the head/body line reserves; normalize text-run widths.
components/account/AccountHubSkeletons.tsx: apply the rule - keep card/row structure and control reserves; normalize text widths and decorative shapes.

components/payments/PaymentFormSkeleton.tsx, components/payments/CheckoutSummarySkeleton.tsx, components/payments/SavedCardRow (if it renders a skeleton): keep field/summary row heights and any card-brand/logo reserves; normalize text widths.
components/onboarding/OnboardingSpineSkeleton.tsx, components/onboarding/EmbeddedPayoutStep (skeleton parts): keep step rail geometry and control reserves; normalize text widths.

components/layout/MarketplaceShellSkeleton.tsx: this is the catalog/home shell - be conservative; keep the rail, header, and all chrome reserves. Only normalize clear inner text texture. If it mostly composes catalogSkeletons/WorkspaceSkeletons, little may change.

app/(marketing)/loading.tsx, app/(marketing)/help/loading.tsx: flat prose columns - these are already uniform TextLines stacks; normalize any stray texture widths (w-24, w-40, w-32, w-full, w-4/5, w-1/3, w-2/5, w-1/2) to the canonical set, keeping the phone-vs-md line-count reservations.

Remaining smaller loading.tsx not explicitly listed (purchases, offers, notifications, sales/trades (list), saved, messages (inbox), messages/[id], sales/[id], trades/[id], profile (hub), listings/new, listings/[id]/edit, t/[token]): most delegate to the shared primitives already fixed in FEAT-001. For any that inline their own Skeleton/TextLines texture, apply the same normalization. Do a grep for '<Skeleton' and '<TextLines' under app/ and components/ to confirm none were missed.

After editing, do a final grep for literal texture widths (w-10, w-14, w-28, w-36, w-44, w-3/5, w-2/5, w-3/4, w-4/5, w-1/3 etc.) across the skeleton files and confirm each remaining instance is intentionally load-bearing (reserves real space), not stray texture. The goal is even visual weight everywhere.
acceptance_criteria: Every listed skeleton/loading file reduces inner texture (fewer distinct bar widths, no shaped-circle/badge texture beyond neutral same-size boxes, uniform chat-bubble heights) while preserving every reserved dimension, breakpoint gate, aspect frame, grid/strip constant, and TextLines type-scale class.
Texture text-bar widths across all files are drawn from the canonical set {w-1/3, w-1/2, w-2/3, w-full}; remaining literal/fraction widths are only those that reserve real layout space.
No reserved footprint changes anywhere - a diff review shows only texture-level edits and comment updates.
A grep for <Skeleton / <TextLines under app/ and components/ shows no skeleton file left with the old busy multi-width texture pattern.
All load-bearing comments are preserved and updated to match the calmer approach.
verification: Grep for '<Skeleton' and '<TextLines' under app/ and components/ and spot-check each file's diff shows only texture/comment changes, never reserved-geometry changes.
Re-read ContractRoomSkeleton, listings/[id] detail loading, and (home) loading diffs to confirm the busiest cases now read calm and even and that no breakpoint gate or fixed height moved.
DO NOT run build/test/lint/dev. Rely on editor diagnostics for TS correctness. The user runs the e2e skeleton-fidelity and layout-shift probes on their own cadence; neither asserts specific widths.
findings: Propagated the FEAT-001 calm/uniform rule to every remaining per-feature *Skeleton and route loading.tsx. Texture text-run widths collapsed to the canonical set {w-1/3, w-1/2, w-2/3, w-full} (final-line taper w-1/3/w-1/2); every reserved footprint kept. app/globals.css and components/ui/skeleton.tsx untouched. Per-file: (1) app/(workspace)/listings/[id]/(detail)/loading.tsx: all PhoneStack + DesktopPane TextLines runs -> canonical; KEPT gallery min-h-[22rem], four size-14 rail thumbs, aspect-[4/5] carousel, min-h-11 seller row, size-7/size-10/size-12/size-8 avatars+chips, ml-region inset, h-5 w-16 condition pill, h-7/h-8/h-10 controls, the desktop back-nav h-7 w-40 and three h-[1.425rem] badge boxes (honest badge/button reserves, already neutral), the 4-line description clamp and 2-line meta reservations. (2) components/auth/AuthFormSkeleton.tsx: text runs -> canonical; KEPT h-11/h-9/h-8 field+button heights, min-h-11 rows, size-5 checkbox, 'or' hairline w-4, and the sign-in-vs-sign-up conditional + the sm:hidden collapse line. (3) components/listings/ItemFormSkeleton.tsx: labels/counter/tile text -> canonical; KEPT all h-9/md:h-8 controls, h-[108px] textarea, aspect frames, grid templates, create-vs-edit mode gates, legend pb-snug. (4) app/(workspace)/admin/(console)/loading.tsx: CustodyPanel/QueueCards/QueueIntro headings + the md:w-3/5 taper helper -> canonical; KEPT size-4 icons, h-6 badges, h-8/md:h-7 buttons, h-16 slab, all QueueIntro desktopLines/md:hidden line-count reservations, SectionHeader width props (caller reserves). (5) app/(workspace)/trades/new/loading.tsx: header/requested-item/DialogRow/running-total runs -> canonical; KEPT size-12 thumb, size-4 checkbox, h-9/md:h-8 footer buttons. (6) app/(workspace)/listings/mine/loading.tsx: ROW_TITLE_WIDTHS six-value spread collapsed to a two-width alternating set, stat figure/meta/price/desktop-column caption runs -> canonical; KEPT ROW_GRID, size-12 thumb, border-transparent focus reserve, h-[1.425rem] badge reserves, h-8/md:h-7 action, StatSkeleton labelWidth caller reserves. (7) app/(workspace)/admin/arbitration/(queue)/loading.tsx: stats/title/description/reason/parties runs -> canonical; KEPT h-6 badges, h-8 buttons, md:hidden reason line reservation, SectionHeader props. (8) components/deals/DealInviteSkeleton.tsx: fact label/value + footer-note runs -> canonical; KEPT both shell branches, staff gate, size-16 card-fact thumb, h-9/md:h-8 button, footer two-line reserve. (9) app/(workspace)/sellers/[id]/loading.tsx: nav/name/rating/social/band-heading/fact-value runs -> canonical; KEPT size-10 avatar, h-5 w-20 pill, h-[1.175rem]/min-h-6 fixed rows, h-8 report button, FACT_GRID, FactSkeleton labelWidth caller reserves. (10) app/(marketing)/safety/loading.tsx: heading/lede/warning/panel/stage runs -> canonical; KEPT max-w-prose column, cardtrade-warning box, size-9 stage markers, nested bordered boxes, all md: line-count gates. (11) app/(workspace)/(home)/loading.tsx: CONSERVATIVE - header title/count + FilterRail label/value runs -> canonical; KEPT the mobile genre strip cells (h-14, size-5, h-3 label, underline slot), size-4/size-11 reserves, GenreStripSkeleton, h-8 w-[190px] filter, and the DESKTOP genre-pill width array (horizontal scroll strip, left verbatim), stat-row h-10 cells. (12) app/(workspace)/admin/arbitration/[kind]/[ref]/loading.tsx: CasePanel title + status-strip back-link/meta/amount runs -> canonical; KEPT h-6 badges, h-24/h-32/h-40/h-56 body slabs, min-h-11 back row, SectionHeader props. (13) app/onboarding/loading.tsx: welcome title/desc/point + seller title runs -> canonical; KEPT size-8 welcome/info markers, h-9 footer button + invisible slot, OnboardingSpineSkeleton, body line-count reservations. (14) components/account/AccountHubSkeletons.tsx + the shared SettingsRowSkeleton in components/account/SettingsPrimitives.tsx (defaults w-28/w-20 -> w-1/3, internal description w-3/4 -> w-2/3): all row label/value props and PayoutsPanel runs -> canonical; KEPT icon/description/valueClassName=hidden reservation flags, size-9 medallions, h-12/h-36 slabs, md:hidden two-line meta reservation (w-11/12 -> w-full). (15) components/payments/CheckoutSummarySkeleton.tsx + SavedCardRow.tsx skeleton + EmbeddedPayoutStep.tsx starting-phase skeleton: text runs -> canonical; KEPT size-5 glyphs, h-8/md:h-7 buttons, h-10 field reserves, h-60 Payment Element reserve. PaymentFormSkeleton already canonical (no change). (16) components/onboarding/OnboardingSpineSkeleton.tsx: step title -> canonical; KEPT size-7 markers, 3px rails, h-9 action, two-line body reservation. (17) components/layout/MarketplaceShellSkeleton.tsx: CONSERVATIVE - only the titleless-fallback TextLines w-24 -> w-1/3; rail/chrome/insets untouched. (18) app/(marketing)/loading.tsx + help/loading.tsx: flat-prose heading/lede/section runs -> canonical, keeping phone-vs-md line-count reservations and md: gates. (19) Shared primitives also touched because they feed the home/sellers loaders: components/layout/catalogSkeletons.tsx catalog tile (title taper/category/price/seller-name -> canonical, 2-line title + fixed h-6 seller row kept) and the SellerReviewsFallback in app/(workspace)/sellers/[id]/page.tsx (review-row runs -> canonical). Smaller list loaders (saved, purchases, offers, sales/(list), sales/[id], trades/[id], messages, listings/new, listings/[id]/edit, t/[token]) delegate to the shared primitives already fixed and needed no inline change; trades/(list) group-heading and notifications unread-count/bucket-heading + profile/(hub) identity-header runs were normalized. Final grep confirms no single-literal w-28..w-72 TextLines runs and no stray w-2/5|w-3/5|w-4/5|w-3/4|w-11/12 texture remain outside intentional reserves (the home desktop genre-pill scroll strip, SectionHeaderSkeleton caller-override width props, and FEAT-001's uniform ContractRoom/WorkspaceSkeletons choices). All load-bearing comments preserved and updated to describe the calmer approach. Per user/steering rules, did NOT run build/typecheck/lint/test/dev; relied on editor diagnostics. Not committed (environment is apply-edits-directly).
